verdict.rationale: Shopify documents its own Global Catalog, which lets AI agents search and discover products across the whole Shopify ecosystem through UCP and MCP. That is a first-party, cross-merchant catalog built for agents, and the pricing page markets selling in AI chats. However, the evidence never shows how a merchant's products enter or are exposed in that catalog, and it says nothing about answer engines beyond agent builders, so complete coverage is not shown. missing for 10: documented merchant-side inclusion or opt-in to the Global Catalog, explicit coverage of answer engines or AI chat surfaces, detail on catalog or feed depth, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, my products are discoverable by AI agents and answer engines through a cross-merchant catalog or feed built for agents

citations.quote: enables AI agents to search and discover products across the entire Shopify ecosystem
Build AI agents that authenticate with Shopify, search the Catalog, build carts and checkouts, and monitor orders using the Universal Commerce Protocol (UCP).
Build agentic shopping experiences powered by Shopify merchants, from product discovery to checkout.
Sell online, in person, and in AI chats
